description: This file sets up the routing configuration for a Vue.js application using vue-router. It defines the routes, including lazy-loaded components, for navigating between different views such as Home and About.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates and configures a new Vue Router instance with specified history and route definitions.

methods.name: createWebHistory
methods.description: Creates a history mode for the router that leverages the browser's history API.
